secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Without it the AI endpoints answer 503 and the app falls back to offline content.

secrets.name: ELEVEN_API_KEY
secrets.description: ElevenLabs API key from https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys. Without it text-to-speech responses report x-elevenlabs-missing and the UI stays silent.
